name: pages
title: Pages
description: Publish human-readable task outputs as DB-backed shareable pages (HTML or JSON) via `create_page`, with no server and no tunnel. Covers auth modes, share URLs, versioning, the injected browser SDK, the `<swarm-diff>` web component, print/PDF export, and limits. Also covers the swarm design system every page should use: theme tokens, `swarm-*` primitives, Tailwind v4 utilities, theme presets, dark mode, and the minimalist taste and report-density rules.
